description: EE2: a damaging hit ends Illusion, after which Transform works. p2's Zoroark leads with Garchomp after it (`pokemon.illusion` set). The turn: Zoroark's Nasty Plot, Garchomp's Swords Dance, then Hariyama's Seismic Toss hits Zoroark (Illusion's `onDamagingHit` runs its `End`: the illusion is gone), and Ditto (Limber, slower) transforms into it (+2 SpA copied).
